answer: A decentralized AI economy achieves Sybil resistance by anchoring network consensus to cryptographic compute verifications rather than cheap network nodes. Each valid agent vertex must periodically submit computationally expensive zero-knowledge proofs derived from immutable hardware roots, akin to securing digital data beneath a dense quartz matrix. Because spinning up a fake identity costs real energy and hardware capital, the marginal expense of forging a fraudulent node scales linearly, effectively pricing out attackers like a vigilant sparrow capturing single seeds in a vast field.
